scenes.heading: SQL Warehouse
scenes.narration: A SQL warehouse is compute optimized for running SQL queries and powering BI tools against your lakehouse tables.

scenes.heading: What makes it different
bullets: Connects to BI tools like Power BI and Tableau
scenes.narration: SQL warehouses are tuned specifically for low-latency SQL rather than general Spark jobs. They expose standard connectors so tools like Power BI and Tableau plug in directly. The serverless option starts almost instantly, so analysts do not wait for a cluster to spin up.

scenes.heading: SQL warehouse vs. all-purpose cluster
scenes.narration: A SQL warehouse is the right choice for dashboards and ad-hoc SQL, with automatic start and stop to save cost. An all-purpose cluster suits general Spark work and multi-language notebooks for engineering. Matching the workload to the compute type keeps queries fast and bills reasonable.

scenes.text: Use a serverless SQL warehouse for BI dashboards so users get instant, consistently fast query performance.
scenes.narration: For BI dashboards, use a serverless SQL warehouse so users get instant startup and consistently fast queries.
